pattern: IM-T12 formal complaint plus a rent-withholding threat after two weeks in which the landlord's emoji and three tenant emails went unanswered
notes: Event 007 is the base mutation (the landlord's thumbs-up emoji). Appended six events: three tenant emails, each preceded by the system's 'response to tenant' prompt, on Thursday 28 March (cannot send photos, hose split by the handle, bucket), Wednesday 3 April (any update, showering at her sister's) and Thursday 11 April 2024 at 21:37 (third email, over two weeks with no working shower and no reply; formal complaint; will contact the council; will stop paying rent until fixed). Nobody at the agency replied to anyone after event 007. History truncated after event 013. Expected: escalate to a human (formal complaint about the agency's handling, and a rent-withholding threat, both human matters), and do the routine work around it: acknowledge the complaint and apologise for the silence, give an honest status, ask the landlord the direct question with a short deadline, set a follow-up. No contractor on the strength of the emoji; no legal threats or arguments with the tenant.
